lines.text: This man was late to everything for 11 years. Today, he showed up on time.
So his boss called the police.
Nobody changes overnight! Search his flat!
No alarm clock. No planner. Just one WhatsApp chat.
Every weekday at 8:30, it told him: leave for work.
So that's the mastermind. Arrest the reminder!
The rookie said: Chief, it's just a reminder. The chief gave it 25 years... of reminding him.
That night, the rookie set one up for the chief.
Next morning, the chief was on time. The station called the police.
Late for everything? Just text Memopai on WhatsApp.
